items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I've got a (?) record here that somebody gave me up in Boston, of Arthur Pryor(singing)Aida.

ctx.x: Usually they say, because there are not too many recorded examples of trombones playing ballad style until maybe some early Tommy Dorsey things.
